ACT XXIII OF1991
ACT XXIII OF1991
ZAKAT AND USHR
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to
amend the Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 24th December, 1991]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 21st
December, 1991, and is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement.------(1) This Act may be called the Zakat and Ushr
(Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall conic into force at
once.

2. Amendment of section 8,
Ordinance XVIII of 1980.--In the Zakat and Ushr Ordinance 1980 (XVIII of
1980), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 8, in clause
(b), for the first proviso the following shall be substituted namely,---
"Provided that the
expenditure on the Central Zakat Council and the administrative organization of
the Administrator-General shall he met by the Federal Government, that on a.
Provincial Zakat Council and the administrative organization of a Chief
Administrator and that on a District Committee. Tehsil Committee, Taluqa
Committee or Sub-Divisional Committee by the Provincial Government concerned,
and that on a Local Committee from the Local Zakat Fund not exceeding ton per
cent. of the receipts in that Fund during the year.".
